findings.problem: BP04 promises old bytes/state for an undifferentiated crash, but a successful rename has already committed the new sidecar before memory/UI publication.
findings.concrete_boundary: Crash after rename(temp,path)==OK and before state=candidate. On next process load the valid new history/completed must remain authoritative, not be rolled back to old bytes.
findings.minimal_fix: Define pre-rename failures versus post-rename committed recovery. Precommit retains old state/path and ignores stale tmp. Postcommit reload accepts the one committed fact, no duplicate reward/write; UI acknowledgement is not the commit boundary. Update BP04 accordingly.
findings.required_future_verification: Process interruption before rename and after rename/before in-memory publish, then fresh load and duplicate exit/once checks. These tests are future required; not executed here.

findings.problem: The future session generation is not explicitly bound to the active trusted profile/canonical Store/durable prerequisite and safe return owner. Current Service has store/session/pending_replay only; the existing journal is hosted by Bootstrap, not an arbitrary campaign safe-scene resume manager.
findings.concrete_boundary: Launch unfinished bonus from profileA with its prerequisite, then trusted owner switches to profileB/replaces Store or startsNewGame before delayed exit. A still-matching scene attempt generation alone cannot authorize that callback against the new owner/prerequisite.
findings.minimal_fix: Specify a service-owned launch token pinning profile identity+canonical Store/profile generation, bonus ID/host/attempt and trusted safe return target. Revoke on profile/NewGame/store replacement; revalidate same owner and current durable prerequisite before commit and before any idempotent-success shortcut. Define legal duplicate completion versus canceled/stale/replay requests. Narrow first return policy to the actual Bootstrap journal or explicitly declare another reviewed adapter prerequisite; no generic scene resume implied.
findings.required_future_verification: ProfileA→B, NewGame-in-same-profile and canonical-store replacement with queued old exit cannot write either profile or grant completion; valid same-session duplicate is idempotent; cancel/readonly replay never obtains first-completion authority.
